mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user r LEFT JOIN metal_factory f ON f.factory_id=r.factory_id AND f.del_flag='0' WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.factory_id=#{factoryId} ORDER BY r.user_id DESC
SELECT FROM sys_user r LEFT JOIN metal_factory f ON f.factory_id=r.factory_id AND f.del_flag='0' WHERE r.user_id=#{id} AND r.del_flag='0'
SELECT FROM sys_user r LEFT JOIN metal_factory f ON f.factory_id=r.factory_id AND f.del_flag='0' WHERE r.user_id=#{id} AND r.del_flag='0' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET phonenumber=#{phonenumber},nick_name=#{nickName},factory_id=#{factoryId},status=#{status},user_name=#{userName},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE user_id=#{id} AND del_flag='0' AND version=#{version}
UPDATE sys_user SET del_flag='2',version=version+1,update_by=#{actor},update_time=NOW() WHERE user_id=#{id} AND del_flag='0'
